theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tpf_blowUp_support_slab
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (σ β : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ y ∈ T.support, dist y x < σ → ‖(y - x) - Q.starProjection (y - x)‖ < β * σ) → ∀ u ∈ (blowUp T x σ hσ.ne').support, ‖u‖ < 1 → ‖u - Q.starProjection u‖ < β
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
